name: andyawd-marketplace

plugins.name: antigravity-cli-statusline
plugins.description: Customize the Antigravity CLI statusline (footer) with quota, token, context, model, git branch and more across macOS / Linux / Windows.
plugins.author: andyawd

plugins.name: antigravity-git-flow
plugins.description: Antigravity plugin for generating Conventional Commits with Git Flow branching.
plugins.author: AndyAWD <anandydy529@gmail.com>

plugins.name: antigravity-github-flow
plugins.description: Antigravity plugin for Conventional Commits and lightweight GitHub Flow branching.
plugins.author: AndyAWD <anandydy529@gmail.com>

plugins.name: antigravity-google-drive
plugins.description: Google Drive 雲端硬碟整合外掛程式，透過 Google Cloud 服務帳戶唯讀存取指定共用資料夾，支援搜尋、目錄瀏覽與自動將 Google 文件轉換為 Markdown/純文字檢視。
plugins.author: AndyAWD
suggestedPrompts: 請搜尋 Google 雲端硬碟中的相關檔案

讀取並摘要 Google 雲端硬碟中的指定文件內容

plugins.name: antigravity-state
plugins.description: Google Antigravity plugin for STATE.md long-horizon task state management.
plugins.author: AndyAWD

plugins.name: antigravity-chinese-copywriting
plugins.description: Antigravity plugin for Chinese Copywriting Guidelines (sparanoid/chinese-copywriting-guidelines) - auto-spacing, full-width punctuation, and proper-noun casing across Antigravity CLI (agy), IDE, and Antigravity 2.0 (Desktop).
plugins.author: AndyAWD <anandydy529@gmail.com>

plugins.name: antigravity-help
plugins.description: Comprehensive knowledge base and help assistant for the entire Google Antigravity ecosystem (including Antigravity CLI, Antigravity IDE, Antigravity 2.0 Desktop, and Antigravity Python SDK) and Customization System (Skills, Rules, Plugins, Hooks, MCP).
plugins.author: andyawd

plugins.description: Standard documentation templates and AI generators for Google Antigravity (AGY) plugins.
plugins.author: Google Antigravity
